name: Machine Learning
description: Data, mathematics, modeling, evaluation, experimentation, and responsible machine-learning foundations.

skills.name: NumPy Foundations
skills.description: Use arrays, vectorized operations, shapes, broadcasting, and numerical computation.

skills.name: Pandas Foundations
skills.description: Load, inspect, transform, join, and summarize tabular data.

skills.name: Data Cleaning
skills.description: Identify and handle missing, invalid, duplicated, and inconsistent data.

skills.name: Data Visualization
skills.description: Choose and interpret visualizations that reveal distributions and relationships.

skills.name: Descriptive Statistics
skills.description: Interpret center, spread, distribution shape, and summary statistics.

skills.name: Probability Foundations
skills.description: Reason about events, conditional probability, expectation, and uncertainty.

skills.name: Linear Algebra Foundations
skills.description: Work with vectors, matrices, transformations, and dot products.

skills.name: Train/Validation/Test Splits
skills.description: Separate data correctly and prevent evaluation leakage.

skills.name: Regression
skills.description: Train, interpret, and evaluate regression models.

skills.name: Classification
skills.description: Train and evaluate classifiers under class and threshold tradeoffs.

skills.name: Clustering
skills.description: Apply and evaluate unsupervised grouping methods.

skills.name: Feature Engineering
skills.description: Create, encode, scale, and select useful model inputs without leakage.

skills.name: Model Evaluation
skills.description: Choose metrics and interpret performance, calibration, and uncertainty.

skills.name: Generalization and Overfitting
skills.description: Recognize bias, variance, overfitting, underfitting, and leakage.

skills.name: Cross-Validation
skills.description: Use appropriate resampling strategies for reliable model selection.

skills.name: Neural Network Foundations
skills.description: Reason about layers, activations, loss, optimization, and training behavior.

skills.name: Responsible Machine Learning
skills.description: Evaluate data rights, bias, privacy, explainability, and deployment impact.
